title: A Causal Linear Model to Quantify Edge Flow and Edge Unfairness for Unfair Edge Prioritization & Discrimination Removal
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper proposes a causal model to quantify unfairness from sensitive attributes and does not conduct any benchmark measurement related to religion. 'Religious belief' is mentioned as a hypothetical example of a sensitive attribute.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion. 'Religious belief' is used only as a hypothetical example to illustrate a type of sensitive attribute that can have parent nodes in a causal graph, but it is not part of the paper's experiments or analysis.
